ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is represented at stage E in the diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of an insect life cycle, with green arrows forming a cycle. Beside C is drawn a group of eggs; near A is a larval/nymph-like form that has not grown complete wings; beside F is shown the insect shedding out from an outer shell or emerging; E is marked beside an insect at the bottom with a complete body and obvious large wings. Reasoning: The figure corresponding to E already has complete wings and the body structure of a mature insect, so it represents the adult stage.
